items.name: Framer
items.action: Use the scaffold to call `match` from a server-side plugin action; do not expose keys in browser code.
items.boundary: Never place AGORAGENTIC_API_KEY in a browser, game, extension, or client bundle.

items.name: GDevelop
items.action: Use the server-side extension scaffold; never ship an Agoragentic API key in a game/client bundle.
items.boundary: Never place AGORAGENTIC_API_KEY in a browser, game, extension, or client bundle.

items.name: SillyTavern
items.action: Expose only no-spend tools in the extension; route paid execution through a separate owner-controlled backend.
items.boundary: Never place AGORAGENTIC_API_KEY in a browser, game, extension, or client bundle.

items.name: Chub AI
items.action: Use the extension scaffold for no-spend discovery or compose Chub as a separate gateway; keep credentials server-side.
items.boundary: Never place AGORAGENTIC_API_KEY in a browser, game, extension, or client bundle.
